lang.label: Language
app.title: Literature counts — metabolite × biofluid
app.caption: Retrieves publication counts from PubMed (E-utilities) and Europe PMC, writes them into the workbook and compares how the two sources rank the metabolites.
source.primary_help: This source drives column E, the share column and the sort order. The other one is written from column I onwards.
pubmed.delay_help: Without a key the limit is 3 requests/s. 0.40 s stays on the safe side.
pubmed.nokey: Running without a key — the 3 requests/s limit applies.
epmc.synonym_help: When on, the count is no longer traceable to your own SYNONYMS dictionary.
epmc.human_filter_help: Verify the field name in the Advanced Search Query Builder; leave empty to apply no filter.
cache.cloud_note: The file system is not persistent on Streamlit Cloud — export the cache after a run.
output.pct_value: Write the share as a value
output.pct_help: When off a formula is written and the file has to be opened and saved once.
info.primary: →  **{name}** will be written to the workbook
syn.error: JSON error, the default dictionary will be used: {err}
upload.label: Workbook (.xlsx)
upload.hint: Expected layout: header in row 4, C = metabolite (EN), E = count, F = share, H = query.
sheets.label: Sheets to process
eta: {sheets} sheets · {queries} queries · estimated time without cache ≈ {minutes} min
sheet.empty: No data found on this sheet.
cmp.only_one: In the top {n} of one source only: {items}
cmp.note: A high ρ means the metabolite selection is insensitive to the choice of database — a more defensible statement than a single list of counts.
footer: Counts depend on the query and on the date. The log file carries the source, the query and the retrieval time for every row; all three belong in the report.
